title: Bali Escape with Beach Club and ATV
alt: Beach club pool above the sand at Canggu, Bali
transport: Private transfers and guided day tours

stops.name: Ubud
stops.subtitle: Ubud to Tirta Empul
stops.accom: 2 nights · Room only · Super deluxe room · 4★ · Private pool villas in the rice fields near Sanur

activities.name: Central Bali with Tirta Empul
activities.match: Central Bali Sightseeing Tour with Tirta Empul
activities.description: A full day through central Bali: the Bali swing, Tegenungan waterfall, the holy spring temple at Tirta Empul and a photo stop at the rice terraces.

activities.name: Ubud art market
activities.description: Two floors of carvings, batik, woven bags and silver in the middle of town, quietest and cheapest when the stalls first open.

program.name: Ubud
program.description: Two nights in a private pool villa, with a full day through the swings, waterfalls and spring temples of central Bali.

stops.name: Kuta
stops.subtitle: Kuta to Pandawa and Nusa Penida
stops.accom: 3 nights · Breakfast · Super deluxe room · 4★ · Design hotel facing Kuta beach with a rooftop pool

activities.name: Tandem ATV ride
activities.description: A two seat quad bike route through rice fields, a river crossing and a cave tunnel, with helmets, boots and a guide ahead of you.

activities.name: Finns Beach Club
activities.description: Day beds, pools and a sound system on the sand at Canggu, with entry and transfers included for an easy afternoon by the sea.

activities.name: Pandawa beach and Uluwatu
activities.description: The limestone cut road down to Pandawa beach, then the cliff top temple at Uluwatu timed for sunset over the Indian Ocean.

activities.name: Nusa Penida west with Paluang cliff
activities.description: Speedboat across for Kelingking beach, Angel's Billabong, Broken Bay and the Paluang cliff viewpoint above the water.

program.name: Kuta
program.description: Three nights in a design hotel on Kuta beach, with a quad bike morning, a Canggu beach club, Pandawa and Uluwatu, and a Nusa Penida day.

1: Arrival at Ngurah Rai Airport and private transfer to your hotel
Check in at your private pool villa
Rest of the day free in the rice fields
Optional: the Ubud art market or a floating breakfast at the villa
2: A full day out with your own car and guide
The Bali swing and Tegenungan waterfall
Tirta Empul, the holy spring temple
A photo stop at the Tegalalang rice terraces
3: Check out, then a tandem quad bike route in the morning
Rice fields, a river crossing and a cave tunnel
Afternoon at Finns Beach Club on the Canggu sand
Private transfer to your beachfront hotel in Kuta
4: Breakfast, then south to the Bukit peninsula
Pandawa beach below its limestone cliffs
Uluwatu temple above the surf at sunset
Optional: the Kecak fire dance at the temple
5: Early breakfast, then private transfer to Sanur harbour
Speedboat across to Nusa Penida for the west coast
Kelingking beach, Angel's Billabong and the Paluang cliff
Return boat to Bali and back to your hotel
6: Breakfast at the hotel and check out
Private transfer to Ngurah Rai Airport for your flight home

expert.name: Putu
expert.quote: Four star hotels, a private pool villa and a beach club, under thirty thousand rupees. The best value week we sell.
expert.tip: The villa nights come without breakfast, which is why the price works, and there are good warungs two minutes away. Add a floating breakfast for one morning if you want the photograph.

summary: Six days on a small budget with a private pool villa and a design hotel on Kuta beach, a central Bali day with Tirta Empul, a tandem quad bike route, Finns Beach Club, Pandawa and Uluwatu, and a full day on Nusa Penida.
included: Included: 5 nights, with breakfast on the three Kuta nights; private airport and inter city transfers; central Bali tour with Tirta Empul; tandem ATV ride; Finns Beach Club entry; Pandawa beach and Uluwatu sunset tour; Nusa Penida west coast tour.
not_included: Not included: international flights; Indonesia visa fees; breakfast on the villa nights; lunches and dinners; travel insurance; personal expenses.
